digest.component_or_area: Local archive and git exclusion management
propositions: A raw transcript from a 2026-08-16 rebar-janitor recovery session must be preserved byte-for-byte in the project-local archive directory (.joe-janitor/)
The destination file (.joe-janitor/raw-chat-2026-08-16.md) must be excluded from repository tracking via .git/info/exclude to remain local-only
Source and destination integrity must be verified via SHA-256 checksum, byte count, line count, and binary comparison before and after preservation
The preserved transcript must colocate with the accompanying recovery report (.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md) in the checkout-local archive
No tracked repository files or production code must be modified by this preservation task
